mentions.name: Open-source hobbyist analog computer
mentions.description: A hobbyist general-purpose analog computer that will be open-sourced, built as a finished PCB with op-amp-based adders and integrators. Inspired by early-1970s hobbyist magazine circuits for simulating lunar landings with op-amps and panel meters, it serves as a hands-on kit for learning analog computing (also built with KiCad and SMT).
